answer: Because the sable audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and therefore paying the ledge bond on all of them and exposing each to the nectar slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 13 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm of 213 pays that 180 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
